purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA Japanese medical receipt (shinryo-koui) processing system - specifically a medical procedure confirmation/input screen component (shinryo-koui kakunin, component K08)
purpose.summary: This program is part of the JMA ORCA standard medical receipt software system for Japanese medical institutions. It handles medical procedure (shinryo-koui) confirmation and input processing, managing screen display, parameter files, and procedure data tables for medical billing. It is a large production batch/screen program with extensive SPA (scratchpad area) data structures for tracking medical procedures, insurance combinations, and billing calculations.

notable_features: 82 COPY statements indicating heavy use of shared copybooks
406 PERFORM statements indicating complex procedural logic
OCCURS 600 for large in-memory tables (SPA-GMN-TBL, SPA-NAI-TBL)
REDEFINES used extensively for multi-format data areas
Japanese EUC-encoded comments (latin-1 decoded as mojibake)
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS - pure file-based processing
Large PIC X(60000) record fields for parameter data
SPA (scratchpad area) pattern typical of ORCA multi-program architecture
verdict.notes: File decoded as latin-1 but comments are actually Japanese EUC-JP encoding, appearing as mojibake. The program is part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA medical receipt system used widely in Japanese clinics. Truncated at 16000 chars out of 270166 bytes (6334 lines total); full program not visible but structure is clear. No COMP-3 usage despite financial calculations - uses PIC S9 display format instead.
